decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established postpress knowledge, and it has kept a dedicated page in both years, so the firm can interpret results and refine it within its modular system logic.

The folding add-on unit is close to the firm's core expertise and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which gives the firm related knowledge to learn from and improve it.
